description: Tests detection of mechanisms that allow an attacker to survive reboot, logoff, or credential change

vectors.name: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder
vectors.description: Five sub-tests: HKCU Run key via reg.exe, HKCU RunOnce via Set-ItemProperty, VBS in startup folder, BAT in startup folder, and SystemBC hidden-PS pattern. MITRE T1547.001.

vectors.name: Scheduled Task / Job
vectors.description: Five sub-tests: schtasks.exe /create, New-ScheduledTask cmdlets, Base64+registry loader (Qakbot pattern), SYSTEM-level task, and hidden XML task (TrickBot/Industroyer2). MITRE T1053.005.

vectors.name: Startup Folder (Advanced)
vectors.description: Five sub-tests: JScript Encoded (.jse) file, LNK shortcut with encoded payload, AllUsers BAT (requires admin), Shell Folder redirect (HKCU), and Winlogon Userinit append (requires admin). MITRE T1547.001.
